message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 74.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Management and system developer. I want to become a Information Technology Auditor. My family can afford at most about USD 6700 per year. I live in Delhi. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Management and system developer roles

explanation:
Northgate School of Engineering
This MBA Technology Management program is recommended because it offers a high placement rate of 90% and a strong median starting salary of $17,361, aligning well with your goal of high employability. The annual tuition of $2,050 fits comfortably within your maximum budget of $6,700, and the location is in Delhi as preferred. However, you should note that your current grade percentage (74.8%) falls below the minimum required grade of 79%, representing a significant admission constraint.

Keystone Technical University
This MBA Technology Management program provides a strong option with an annual tuition of $2,050, which is well within your budget and located in Delhi. Admission requirements are favorable, as your academic background meets the minimum grade percentage of 60%. The main trade-off here is that while the placement rate is solid at 71%, the median starting salary ($8,900) is lower compared to other options on this list.

Stanmore Institute of Applied Sciences
This MBA Business Analytics program is recommended because it offers the lowest tuition cost at $1,450 and provides a relevant field (Business Information Systems) that aligns with both IT auditing and system development interests. Your academic background easily meets the minimum grade requirement of 60%, and the location is in Delhi. The primary trade-off is that its placement rate (76%) and median starting salary ($10,648) are moderate compared to Northgate School of Engineering.
